architecture_selection.single_canonical_scientific_fit: After architecture selection, the seed tagged canonical_fit is the sole latent representation used for factor-level / sample-level scientific comparator outputs. Other seeds are stability diagnostics only.
architecture_selection.stage_1: Five deterministic sample-ID folds; for each candidate, fit one model per fold with the frozen architecture-selection seed and rank by mean held-out reconstruction SSE computed only over observed standardized entries. Retain candidates within one standard error of the best mean reconstruction SSE.
architecture_selection.stage_2: For each stage-1-retained candidate, fit the full analysis dataset with the three frozen stability seeds. Compute median pairwise latent-subspace canonical correlation after orthogonal alignment. Select the highest-stability candidate; exact ties prefer fewer hidden parameters, then lexical candidate_id.

MOVE_scientific_policy.batch_size_rule: min(16, n_fit_samples), with no batch smaller than the available n_fit_samples
MOVE_scientific_policy.optimizer_and_loss: MOVE 1.5.0 public VAE/training_loop implementation without local numerical modification

common_scientific_adapter_policy.feature_selection: Use exactly the frozen outcome-blind Paper 5 feature-budget / preprocessing inputs supplied to the primary benchmark for that dataset or split. The comparator wrapper may not perform outcome-guided feature selection.
common_scientific_adapter_policy.information_boundary: Outcomes, clinical labels, biological annotations, simulation truth, and final-gate labels are forbidden from preprocessing, tuning, architecture selection, fitting, or failure handling.
common_scientific_adapter_policy.missing_feature_values: After standardization, encode remaining missing feature values as 0.0, i.e. the training-set standardized mean.
common_scientific_adapter_policy.sample_pairing: Preserve the frozen sample-ID order and cross-view pairing exactly; no re-pairing is permitted.
common_scientific_adapter_policy.standardization: Within any fit/training split, estimate per-feature center and scale from observed entries in that split only. Apply those parameters to held-out rows. Zero-variance features follow the already-frozen Paper 5 preprocessing policy and are not rescued comparator-specifically.
common_scientific_adapter_policy.whole_view_missingness: Encode an unavailable view as an all-zero standardized row for that view. Do not add comparator-specific missingness indicator features.

iCluster2b_scientific_policy.platform_binary: official Bioconductor 3.23 Windows x86_64 binary for R 4.6
iCluster2b_scientific_policy.scientific_fit_rule: Run one prospectively seeded tune.iCluster2b call per analysis dataset with K=5 and the fixed documented lasso search settings above; use the lambda values returned by that call. No truth, outcome, biological label, or comparator-performance metric may enter tuning.

metric_scope: Only metrics explicitly marked eligible in the frozen metric registry may be used for cross-method claims. Method-specific endpoints remain descriptive and are not inserted into the 05e primary selection score.
post_05e_rule: Only after a frozen successful 05e primary-method decision may scientific secondary-comparator runs begin. Their outputs remain secondary and cannot reopen 05e or the final-gate contract.
primary_rule: Secondary external comparators are frozen as reporting/benchmark methods only. They are categorically ineligible to influence 05e primary-method selection, the frozen final-gate calibration, or TARGET outcome access.
